name: TherapyNotes
short_description: Leading practice management and EHR software built specifically for behavioral health with integrated notes, scheduling, billing, and telehealth.
long_description: TherapyNotes is a comprehensive practice management and electronic health record (EHR) system designed specifically for behavioral health professionals. Founded in 2010 in Horsham, Pennsylvania by Brad Pliner (a web technologies expert) and Dr. Debra Pliner (a clinical psychologist), TherapyNotes has grown to serve therapists, psychologists, psychiatrists, counselors, and social workers across the United States. The platform features interactive note templates built by clinicians for clinicians, integrated scheduling with appointment reminders, electronic insurance billing with ERA processing, a secure client portal, and HIPAA-compliant telehealth. TherapyNotes offers TherapyFuel AI, an AI-powered documentation assistant, and provides 24/7 phone and email support on all plans. The platform is known for its intuitive interface and strong focus on the mental health workflow.
one_liner: The behavioral health EHR built by clinicians, for clinicians.
best_for: Solo and group mental health practices (up to 200 providers) seeking a purpose-built behavioral health EHR
Therapists and psychologists who value clinician-designed note templates
Insurance-heavy practices needing robust claims submission ($0.14/claim) and ERA processing
Psychiatrists and prescribers requiring e-prescribing with EPCS capabilities
Clinicians wanting 24/7 customer support and free data migration from other EMRs
not_for: Multi-specialty medical practices needing a general healthcare EHR
Practices outside the United States (US-focused platform)
Budget-conscious solo practitioners seeking the lowest monthly cost (starts at $69/mo)
Clinicians wanting a mobile-first experience (web-focused with mobile companion app)

pricing.notes: Solo plan: $69/user/month. Group plan: $79/month first clinician + $50/month each additional. Enterprise (30+ users): same rates with dedicated account manager. Unlimited non-clinical staff free.

premium_telehealth.description: HD video, screen sharing, closed captions, up to 16 participants. Basic telehealth (SD, 2 participants) included free.

therapyfuel_ai.description: AI-powered documentation assistant for progress notes

eprescribe.description: E-prescribing with EPCS for controlled substances

faqs.q: How much does TherapyNotes cost per month in 2026?
faqs.a: TherapyNotes Solo plan costs $69/month per user. Group practices pay $79/month for the first clinician plus $50/month for each additional clinician. Administrative staff are unlimited and free. AI add-on (TherapyFuel) is $40/clinician/month.
Yes, TherapyNotes is fully HIPAA compliant and provides a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). All data is encrypted and the platform includes secure telehealth and messaging.

faqs.q: Does TherapyNotes include telehealth video sessions?
faqs.a: Yes, TherapyNotes includes Basic Telehealth at no extra cost on all plans with standard-definition video for up to 2 participants. Premium Telehealth ($15/clinician/month) adds HD video, screen sharing, and closed captions.
TherapyNotes provides 24/7 phone and email support on all plans, free data import from other EMRs, and unlimited training resources. They are known for responsive customer service.

TherapyNotes is best for solo and group mental health practices (up to 200 providers) seeking a purpose-built behavioral health EHR. It is ideal for therapists and psychologists who value clinician-designed note templates, insurance-heavy practices needing robust claims submission, and psychiatrists requiring e-prescribing with EPCS capabilities.
TherapyNotes integrates with Office Ally for electronic claims processing, Google Calendar and iCal for scheduling sync, and includes built-in credit card processing for payments.
